description: Map a plain-language goal (e.g. 'send a transactional email') to callable APIs, MCP servers or CLIs. Returns {need, coverage, count, uncovered, note, matches[]}; each match has slug, endpoint, auth, formats, rate limit, pricing and a 0-100 reliability score. Never empty on a valid need: if nothing fits, coverage='none' and matches[] lists reliable starting points. Errors: an invalid or too-short need fails input validation; a backend failure returns isError=true with the message. Rate limits: 100 calls/day anonymous, 1,000/day with a free key (POST /api/public/keys, no account), 50,000/day on Agent Pro. For a known keyword or slug, use search_registry.

category.description: Restrict to one interface layer ('api', 'mcp' or 'cli' — see list_categories). Default: omitted, searches all three.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching interfaces to return, 1-20. Default 5.

min_reliability.description: Drop interfaces scoring below this 0-100 reliability value. Default 0 (no filter).

need.description: What the agent is trying to accomplish, in plain language. 3-300 characters, required.

name: discover_capabilities
title: Discover a callable interface for a need
